name: How long does it take to install a pocket door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a pocket door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for pocket door installation depends on whether it's part of a new construction project or a renovation. For a renovation involving an existing wall, the process can take several days to a week, including demolition, framing, door installation, drywall repair, and finishing. The complexity of relocating utilities, if present, can significantly extend this duration. Our process typically involves an initial consultation to provide a more accurate project timeline based on your specific site conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from days to a week for renovations, depending on wall modifications and utility relocations. Consultations provide specific timelines.
